gazette_location.description_raw_en: Terrace commencing at its junction with an unnamed road and running in a south-westerly direction for about 70 metres before it bends to run in a north-westerly direction for about 35 metres; it then bends to run in a generally south-westerly direction for about 85 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink on Plan No. LD/TW/R101C.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此台由與一未命名道路交界處起，向西南伸展約七十米，再轉向西北伸展約三十五米，然後屈向西南伸展約八十五米而終止。在 LD/TW/R101C 號圖則上以粉紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with CHEUNG PEI SHAN ROAD and running in a south-easterly direction for about 145 metres where it terminates at its junction with SHING MUN ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. NTA/TW/R103.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與象鼻山路交界處起，向東南伸展約一百四十五米，至與城門路交界處終止。在 NTA/TW/R103 號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with CHEUNG SHAN ESTATE ROAD EAST and running in a south-westerly direction for about 175 metres and then bends to run in a north-westerly direction for about 85 metres where it terminates at its junction with CHEUNG PEI SHAN ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. NTA/TW/R103.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與象山邨東路交界處起，向西南伸展約一百七十五米，再轉向西北伸展約八十五米，至與象鼻山路交界處止。在 NTA/TW/R103 號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with ROUTE TWISK and running in an east north-easterly direction for about 280 metres and then curves to run in a north-easterly direction for about 75 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. LD/TW/R104.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與荃錦公路交界處起，向東北偏東伸展約二百八十米，然後斜向東北伸展約七十五米而終止。在 LD/TW/R104 號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。
